lines.t:
The reduction of the <c:ffff00>{{armor}}<c> of <c:ffff00>{{part|pl}}<c> and <c:ffff00>objects<c>
during a <c:ffff00>{{robattle}}<c>, and its numerical value.
It is mainly caused by <c:ffff00>attacks<c> from <c:ffff00>{{medabot|pl}}<c>, <c:ffff00>Traps<c>
and <c:ffff00>negative statuses<c>. Generally, it affects the
{{armor}} of the {{part}} that <c:ffff00>responds<c>, but depending on
the <c:ffff00>{{damage_trait}}<c> it can also reach other {{part|pl}}.
{{part|pl|cap}} and objects whose {{armor}} reaches 0 are
<c:ffff00>destroyed<c>.
